title: Conditional κ = 0.00364665195644 (0% over #7334): bound original-source retiming and late public donors
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

**NO VERIFIED GAIN.** Exact Δκ = 0, 0% relative to conditional κ = 0.00364665195644 on #7334 aaeec8c0acf01e99a5f331ef363a698d9c084ace with signed #7113 at 07a76c5e2738882c0cb322278e56f6cae3c9885d. Two literal engines exclude all 18,864 typed retiming cuts in five frozen public-source MOVE windows because the original source is on the wrong endpoint chart.

Two rational engines also exclude all ten late public donor banks at the pre-event cut of the old second MOVE. Nine have a single missing coordinate. At chart 207 the input probe with coordinates 58 and 1493 equal to 1 and −1/2 annihilates all eight public donors and evaluates to −1/2 on the original signed ADD contribution. Both tested scopes are exhausted, with zero unresolved keys. Earlier alternate-donor cuts other than the original ADD clock remain open.

Two paid debits would become one direct rank-sum MOVE across 17 caller copies, lowering paid count from 110,519 to 110,502 with 22,461 productive positions unchanged. The directed one-edit upper is 0.277267940905222 raw and the compatible whole upper is 0.774080773065573 raw before ancillary costs. Verified savings are zero.

## Task and overlap

This refines the #7111 incremental investigation on canonical main e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57. #7365 at 98be9db1f28cdc5fa8962c7da065bc0174db9744 supplies the exact predecessor price and original-clock public donor test. #7003 supplies earlier commuting ADD retimes, #7336 tests different public boundaries and #7355 supplies the owned-destination donor engines. This package changes the ADD clock within the five exact public-source windows.

## Validation

From a clean checkout with CPython 3.12:

    python3.12 -I -B research/p104-original-source-retime-late-donor-bound/replay.py
    python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-original-source-retime-late-donor-bound

The package regenerates six receipts, checks all ten exact separators on the original source and every donor row, and rejects altered word and price inputs. Local registered replay, committed source and mode checks, six navigation tests, and the official Git-free export and replay passed. The branch reuses the exact #7257 planner repair d2e54af81f9dda6487636b79d4964a2385d89b2b for hosted verification. No construction or complete κ candidate replay was triggered.

## Credit and open question

#7334 and #7113 supply the exact native comparator and caller. OpenAI Codex and subagents materially assisted the proof, implementation, independent replay and packaging. A next donor test should preprice a capped set of earlier alternate-donor cuts and check exact span before considering any build.
